summary: Tested new Agent Skip KYC feature end-to-end. Backend endpoint POST /api/public/agent-skip-kyc/{user_id} correctly approves KYC, sets password_reset_required=true and generates a reset token while keeping freeze_type='both' and account_status='frozen' unchanged. GET /api/public/agent-my-clients now includes kyc_status per client. Rejects with 400 if already approved and 404 if client not owned by agent. Frontend 'I Miei Clienti' shows purple 'Salta KYC' link for non-approved clients and green 'KYC approvato' label for approved ones. window.confirm dialog + API call + list refresh flow works correctly. All 6 backend tests passed and the full UI flow was validated with agent marco on test_bug20_1782908552@test.com.
critical_code_review_comments: Skip-KYC endpoint sets password_reset_expires to 7 days (delta longer than the standard 1 day used elsewhere). Confirmed to match the requirement, but consider extracting the '7 days' constant to a named config for clarity.

agent_skip_kyc uses db.kyc_documents.update_one with upsert=False silently; if no KYC document exists, the update is a no-op. This is acceptable because the source of truth is the user record, but a debug log line would help traceability.

server.py continues to grow (>4700 lines). Splitting agent-related endpoints (agent-login, agent-create-user, agent-my-clients, agent-update-client, agent-skip-kyc, agent-check-user) into a dedicated router module would improve maintainability.
